warning: A packet is supported only after its server obligation is implemented, persisted and replay-tested.

battle_rush/reward.response: operation type 18000; GiveItems entries carry itemId, amount, missionId and stageId
battle_rush/reward.server_obligation: validate stage/course and first-clear missions; persist Battle Rush claim rows; deliver exact rewards once

cat_diary/reward.request: lotteryDt, slotNo and step from the selected UserCatDiaryChain
cat_diary/reward.response: operation type 24000; client consumes the traced Cat Diary reward and progress fields
cat_diary/reward.server_obligation: validate that exact chain; persist chain/status counters; deliver its weighted original gift once

dungeon/complete.request: dungeonId, only from the roguelike completion path
dungeon/complete.response: common store only; action callback is empty and no operation handler is linked
dungeon/complete.server_obligation: validate a matching active roguelike run; persist its exact completion transition and rewards once

gift/receive.request: userId and IDs extracted from actual UserGift rows
gift/receive.response: operation type 2000 with exact UserGift rows; client applies contents and marks gifts received
gift/receive.server_obligation: atomically consume each pending gift and materialize every typed content exactly once

pack_product/acquire.response: operation type 26000 with limitedLotteryTickets and userPackProduct
pack_product/acquire.server_obligation: validate original cost and purchase limit; debit once; persist product count; materialize every typed content

pc_costume/acquire.response: operation type 25000 with limitedLotteryTickets, pcCostumeProductId and count
pc_costume/acquire.server_obligation: validate original cost and purchase limit; debit once; persist product and costume rows

star_library/level_reward.response: operation type 22000 creates UserGift; after gift pull the client advances level state 1 to 2
star_library/level_reward.server_obligation: create each exact original gift once without prematurely claiming the local level row

star_library/mission_reward.request: missionIds in state 3 or 4 plus bookId
star_library/mission_reward.response: operation type 21000 creates UserGift; after gift pull the client advances mission state 4 to 5
star_library/mission_reward.server_obligation: atomically advance eligible rows 3 to 4 and create each exact original gift once

star_library/score_attack_reward.response: operation type 23000 creates UserGift; after gift pull the client advances reward state 1 to 2
star_library/score_attack_reward.server_obligation: create each exact original gift once without prematurely claiming the local reward row

operation_redelivery: user_data/confirm returns pending operations; user_data/push removes them only after dones by id
